records.part: Replacement of all existing broadcast media equipment supporting the Council Chambers (hardware, software, controllers for internet streaming and TV broadcast)
records.reason: Media Control Systems, Inc. supports current broadcast media equipment, and they are familiar with the interferes to our existing video production equipment.

records.part: Operating system component of broadcast media equipment reaching end-of-life/unsupported status
records.reason: The equipment currently in use was procured and installed in 2019 and has reached the effective end- of-life for most of the components, including Windows 10 that will become unsupported in October 2025.

records.part: 5 (five) years of support and maintenance for new broadcast media equipment
records.reason: Staff negotiated a proposal with Media Control Systems to include 5 (five) years of support and maintenance, incorporating all foreseeable costs into the current project.
